title: Schema for the map layouts data file: the tile sides each map is built from, and where they go

map_id.description: Foreign key to the map in data/maps.json.

tile_id.description: Foreign key to the tile in data/map-tiles.json.

side.description: The side of the tile the map uses.

count.description: The copies of this side the mission takes. A tile that a hidden section reuses (recycles) is placed more often than this, but no one image places it more often.

placements.description: Where the map's images place this side: on the map's image (section null) or on one of its hidden sections' images. Sorted by section (the map's image first, then the hidden sections in order), then y, then x.

section.description: null for the map's image, or the name of one of the map's hidden_sections.

x.description: Squares from the left: the leftmost square of the tile's grid once turned (tabs aren't squares). A map's placements, hidden sections included, share one frame starting at 0.

y.description: Squares from the top: the topmost square of the tile's grid once turned.

rotation.description: Clockwise degrees that turn the side's image (map-tiles side_a or side_b) as placed.
